Whittington Johnson & Ann Rust Norwood

Preserved Primary Document • mitsawokett_report.htm

Descendants of

Whittington Johnson born 1812 in Delaware grandson of Thomas Clark & Elizabeth Morris See http://nativeamericansofdelawarestate.com/ClarkThomas.htm

and his wife

Ann Rust Norwood born abt 1815 in Delaware daughter of Eli Norwood & Anna Rust

Some of the information in this report has been reported to us orally or by email by members of the Mitsawokett research group, without documentation. This report should be used as a guide to further research, not as a definitive report
